header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: and drink, (but they will have no spittle, no urine or stool will come out of them, and there will be no need to clean the nose,” when the Prophet ﷺ said this, the Sahabah asked, “What will become of the food?” (how will) the food (be digested)? “The food will be digested through belching and the coming out of sweat fragrant like musk. Just as the heart keeps working through breathing, the tongues of the people of Jannah will keep moving with the tasbih and praise of Allah,’ Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ نِ الخُدْرِيِّ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: يُنَادِي مُنَادٍ: إِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَصِحُّوا فَلَا تَسْقَمُوا أَبَدًا، وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَحْيَوْا فَلَا تَمُوتُوا أَبَدًا، وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَشِبُّوا فَلَا تَهْرَمُوا أَبَدًا، وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَنْعَمُوا فَلَا تَبْأَسُوا أَبَدًا، فَذلِكَ قَوْلُهُ : (وَنُودُوا أَنْ تِلْكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ۞).
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب في دوام نعيم اهل الجنة .....، رقم:٧١٥٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri and Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) both narrate what Rasulullah ﷺ said: “A caller will announce, “O people of Jannah! You will live in good health and will never again fall ill; an eternal life in which death never comes is ready for you; a youth in which old age never comes awaits you; there will be happiness forever and never any sorrow.” This hadith is the explanation of the following Qur'anic verse (وَنُودُوا أَنْ تِلْكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ)

blocks.text:
Meaning: They will be called and told that this Jannah has been given to you in return for your deeds.
(Muslim)
